title: Resolutions and deformations of cyclic quotient surface singularities
summary: In this paper, we investigate the relations among various results concerning the minimal resolution of cyclic quotient singularities of the form $\mathbb{C}^2/G$. We refer to these as "bamboo-type" singularities, since the dual graphs of the exceptional curves in their resolutions resemble the shape of bamboo. We present classical results on the minimal resolution of singularities, the $G$-Hilbert scheme, the generalized McKay correspondence, deformations of singularities, and quiver varieties.
